PTR fixtures are synthetic, contain no personal financial data, and require no network.

- `house_ptr.pdf` is a valid two-page PDF with three ruled transaction tables. Its
  columns model the existing House parser contract, including a blank ID header,
  a transaction from the prior year, an asset without a ticker, and a partial sale.
- `senate_ptr.html` models the existing Senate electronic PTR table contract,
  including an undisclosed ticker and a prior-year transaction.

These fixtures test ingestion and normalization, not current government website
availability or compatibility with every historical disclosure layout.
